# biff-cloud x402 APIs
> Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents (x402, USDC on Solana).
- [Solana Agent Toolbox](https://solana-agent-toolbox.onrender.com/openapi.json): Solana token safety, tx explainer, preflight, wallet, launches. $0.005/call
- [x402 Health](https://x402-health.onrender.com/llms.txt): x402 endpoint checks, uptime, reliable-service directory. $0.002-0.01/call
